rationale: Although the latest 1-minute candle shows a strong volume surge (80k shares) pushing price above the prior day's high of $13.75, the current bid-ask spread is excessively wide at 65.3 bps ($13.85 by $13.94) and sits well above the last print of $13.79. Conversely, shorting into a 6.40x relative volume breakout above multi-day resistance is not supported by the immediate tape.
